caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a brown, reddish toned surface and visible wood grain texture. The chest is reinforced with multiple dark gray or black metal brackets at the corners and along the edges, including metal plates and hinges on the upper edges and sides. It features a metal handle on the shorter side near the front. In the top left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, uncolored line sketch of the chest accompanied by measurements. The main colored chest is centered within a rectangular border on a light background, and the artist's name, "S. Fineman Del-156-1," is written in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Chest
